a: Coloured squares on a Rubik's Cube
b: Cards in a standard deck, no jokers
explanation: Six faces of nine squares make 54 on a classic 3 by 3 by 3 cube. A deck holds four suits of 13 cards, which makes 52.

claims.text: A standard 3 by 3 by 3 Rubik's Cube has 54 coloured squares: six faces with nine squares each.
A standard deck of playing cards without jokers has 52 cards: four suits of 13.
